text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a tiny regional 'edge cache' to accelerate controlplane handshakes for Private customers. reduce auth chattiness and keep stable egress IPs when privatelink falls back.
ajay: isn't this just another relay?
devon: difference: minimal stateful cache (TTL tokens, cert blobs, ACL) not full proxy. answers handshake and short-lived cert requests only.
sophia: security questions: if cache is compromised, can it mint creds? rotation semantics?
maria: constraint: cache cannot mint long-lived creds. it returns KMS-signed short assertions; HSM-backed keys; revocation check with controlplane; auto-evict on revocation.
ajay: egress IP preservation: per-tenant IPs or shared pool?
devon: MVP: shared regional egress pool with per-tenant mapping; option for dedicated leases for enterprise. lease service with TTL + renewal.
sophia: cost + IPv6 concerns.
maria: IPv4-only MVP; document IPv6 path. Finance gating for large dedicated pools.
infra-bot: deploy-check: rolling canary required for images touching KMS. schedule in us-west-2. ticket INFRA-3493 created.
ajay: onboarding change?
devon: add registry field egress_mode: [privatelink, cache_egress, dedicated_egress]. default keeps current behavior. migration job opt-in.
sophia: testing matrix: privatelink happy path, cache failover handshake, rotation under load, lease exhaustion, revocation storm.
maria: metrics: cache_hit_rate, handshake_latency_ms_p99, lease_in_use, lease_free. alerts for handshake_errors >1% over 5m and low lease_free.
ajay: precedence rules to avoid double-routing?
devon: agent precedence: privatelink > private_endpoint > edge_cache > internet_fallback.
sophia: failure semantics: fail closed for token minting; allow read-only cached responses; return 503 for mutating ops.
maria: ops: require sigstore attestation, mTLS to controlplane, redact tokens in logs. I'll write follow-up RFC + threat model. thumbs?
ajay: :thumbsup: will pair with finance for cost model.
sophia: :thumbsup: drafting console copy.
devon: :thumbsup: prototyping agent cache library.
